title: Arch split packages — failure-mode matrix
summary: Every failure mode the split PKGBUILD must defend against was verified. The matrix covers: SKIP in sha256sums, wrong pkgname count, missing package function, desktop dep leaking into core, core dep leaking into desktop, exact-version dependency not pinned, file conflicts between packages, install hook on desktop packages, PKGBUILD syntax errors, and makepkg --printsrcinfo parse failures. All are caught by the test suite; none are present in the shipped PKGBUILD.

matrix.defect: SKIP in sha256sums (unpinned source or model archive)
matrix.actual: test_arch_split.sh (f) checks for SKIP in sha256sums; current PKGBUILD has zero SKIP entries — both sha256sums are real 64-hex
test_arch_split.sh (a) asserts pkgname_count == 3; current PKGBUILD has exactly namtor, namtor-gnome, namtor-kde

matrix.defect: package function missing (e.g. package_namtor-gnome not defined)
matrix.actual: all three functions exist with hyphenated names (bash allows hyphens in function names); makepkg --printsrcinfo succeeds

matrix.defect: core package depends on a desktop library (gtk4/libadwaita/qt6-base/kirigami/kcoreaddons)
matrix.expected: test fails nonzero — core must be headless-safe
matrix.actual: test_arch_split.sh (c) checks each desktop lib is absent from core depends; current core depends only on onnxruntime, pam, systemd, gcc-libs

matrix.defect: gnome package depends on a Qt/KDE library
matrix.expected: test fails nonzero — gnome must not pull Qt/KDE
matrix.actual: test_arch_split.sh (d) checks qt6-base, kirigami, kcoreaddons absent from gnome depends; current gnome depends only on namtor=$pkgver, gtk4, libadwaita

matrix.defect: kde package depends on a GTK/libadwaita library
matrix.expected: test fails nonzero — kde must not pull GTK
matrix.actual: test_arch_split.sh (e) checks gtk4, libadwaita absent from kde depends; current kde depends only on namtor=$pkgver, qt6-base, kirigami, kcoreaddons

matrix.defect: desktop package depends on namtor without exact version pin (e.g. 'namtor' without =$pkgver)
matrix.expected: test fails nonzero — desktop packages must pin exact core version
matrix.actual: test_arch_split.sh (d/e) checks for 'namtor=$pkgver' literal in depends; both gnome and kde pin exact version

matrix.defect: file conflict: same dest path owned by two packages
matrix.expected: test fails nonzero — pacman refuses conflicting files
matrix.actual: test_arch_split.sh (i) stages each package into separate DESTDIRs and checks for overlapping paths via comm; zero overlaps found

matrix.defect: desktop package has an install hook (should have none)
matrix.expected: test fails nonzero — desktop packages must not have install hooks
matrix.actual: test_arch_split.sh (h) checks neither gnome nor kde package functions set install=; also checks namtor-gnome.install and namtor-kde.install files do not exist
test_arch_split.sh (k) runs bash -n; current PKGBUILD passes

matrix.defect: makepkg --printsrcinfo fails or produces wrong package count
matrix.expected: test fails nonzero — makepkg must parse the split PKGBUILD
matrix.actual: test_arch_split.sh (k) runs makepkg --printsrcinfo and checks for 3 pkgname entries; current PKGBUILD produces correct .SRCINFO with 3 packages

matrix.defect: core package missing mandatory files (daemon, PAM, lifecycle helper, systemd units, model manifest)
matrix.expected: test fails nonzero — core must be self-contained
matrix.actual: test_arch_split.sh (j) stages core and checks for namtor-daemon, pam_namtor.so, lifecycle.sh, namtor-daemon.socket, namtor-daemon.service, sysusers.d/namtor.conf, model-manifest.toml; all present

matrix.defect: core does not stage --package core / bundle models / pre-write licences
matrix.expected: test fails nonzero — core must stage its manifest entries and bundle models
matrix.actual: test_arch_split.sh (c) checks stage.sh --package core, var/lib/namtor/models, and licence.accepted in the core package function body; all present

matrix.defect: kde does not run cmake --install for the QML module
matrix.expected: test fails nonzero — kde must install the CMake-built QML module
matrix.actual: test_arch_split.sh (e) checks for cmake --install in the kde package function body; present

makepkg_function_name_note: makepkg requires the split-package function name to match the pkgname exactly, including hyphens. Bash (non-POSIX mode) allows hyphens in function names with the name() syntax. The PKGBUILD defines package_namtor(), package_namtor-gnome(), and package_namtor-kde(). makepkg --printsrcinfo successfully extracts per-package metadata (depends, pkgdesc, install, provides) from each function body without executing the staging code.
